cases.observation: An extension disconnect left subsequent tool calls unable to reconnect without restarting the MCP server.

rootCause.assessment: Reporter attributes the failure to a missing reconnect path; closure is recorded, not a current-version failure claim.

fawn.ownerMapping: research inference, not assigned implementation work
fawn.doeRelevance: No direct GPU evidence in this report; investigate browser/control boundary first.

reproduction.setup: Disconnect the extension after a successful read, then request another read.
reproduction.passCondition: Reconnect to the same authorized session or report a precise unavailable state; do not repeat earlier mutations.

local.method: Literal error-signature discovery followed by manual inspection of selected tool outputs. Search results, code literals, copied conversations and this research session are excluded from admitted local examples. Repeated matching text is not an incident count.
local.excluded: Compressed Codex archives, browser profiles/cookies, credentials, encrypted/fully undecoded Gemini trajectories, and unrelated content. Gemini history and readable browser notes were inspected; coverage is not exhaustive.

public.method: Targeted web discovery followed by primary GitHub issue metadata/body reads; selected maintainer/reporter comments checked.
public.limit: Convenience sample; no denominator, failure-rate estimate or product ranking.

collectionScope.privacy: Public catalogue retains generic symptoms, minimal error signatures and hashes. Exact private source locations and disputed records are retained in the private owner research repository. Raw histories and private page content are not copied to tracked public files.
